document.about: Owens Corning ProCat professional insulation system accessory list (9 pages, numbered 1 to 9 at the foot). The cover sets a four-line right-aligned 28 pt title with a 5.7 pt raised ® after PROCAT. Each product is a two-column table of fields, `CARTON COUNT | 75`, and the last page closes on a bold contact line above the order table.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#122): a line ending in a web address, a domain, an e-mail address or a phone number was a heading when set bold or large.

2026-11-24 (#99): a cell holding only a number as wide as the page numbers was taken for the page number and emptied: every one-digit count, `CARTON COUNT | 1`, `PALLET COUNT | 9`. A cell is the page's number only as the page's own folio, where page numbers stand.
2026-11-24 (#125, #126): a display title set right-aligned over four lines came out as one heading per line, and the raised ® after its first word was lost.
2026-11-26: the document's title is a `doco:Title`, the document's header, apart from its sections, as a Word document's and a deck's are. The title's checks look for it there.

checks.issue: The bold contact line was a level-6 heading, with the order table nested under it.
The count `1` was emptied as page 1's number.
The count `9` was emptied as page 9's number.
The sheet numbers its pages 1 to 9 at the foot, and no folio is read on any page.
The four right-aligned lines of the cover title were four level-1 headings, one per line.
The 5.7pt raised ® after PROCAT, followed by a space glyph at 16pt on its own baseline, was read as a list marker and dropped.
